oracle.harness: tcp_oracle.c + build.sh + run-goldens.sh (kept off the repository, R14)
oracle.stubs: tcpapi_send, tcpapi_close, tcpapi_recv, tcpapi_set_timeout, tcpapi_reconnect, tcpapi_change_app_state record their calls; output_report_banner, syn_cookie, default_udp_parse, pcapfile_*, preprocess_frame abort if called (banner1_parse never reaches them)
oracle.calls: banner1_create once; per run a zeroed StreamState with the case's port, banout_init, banner1_parse per piece (whole stream, every byte, the given segments), then the records banner_flush reports (list order, length && protocol, app = protocol & 0x0FFFFFFF); each run in a forked child with a 2-second alarm

expected: rmasscan banner_stream on the whole stream, byte by byte, the given segments and 8 random splits: records (each C record cut at 65 536 bytes, R5) and app_proto equal C's whole run for expect=records, actions too on the whole stream; app_proto only for expect=classification; for expect=declared-4b the named 4b rule and C's app_proto: unknown-stream (the whole stream as one unknown record, no action) or starttls-unknown (the first segment ends with the STARTTLS go-ahead line: the text parser record and the actions before the TLS hello of C's run over that segment, the given run when there is a second segment, else the whole run; the bytes of the second segment as one unknown record; no TLS hello)

oracle.harness: request_oracle.c includes tcp_oracle.c with renamed main; unmodified pinned proto-http.c; artifacts off repository (R14)
oracle.calls: banner1_create; copy default hello; http_change_requestline and http_change_field in C3 order; explicit lengths for values, C strings for field names
oracle.sanitizer: recovering AddressSanitizer/UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. Ordinary output is the comparison fixture; E1.7/E1.17 memory defects are documented, allocator bytes are never adopted
